A '''holographic nursery mobile''' was a form of [[Hologram/Legends|holographic technology]] that simulated objects above the bed of an infant. One version on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] contained an [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]], [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]], [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monsters]], [[Mee/Legends|mee]], and [[See/Legends|see]].

While on a mission to Naboo to steal children for [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] came across one of these, before encountering [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].
